status: design (modelled); RTL bench in results/rtl/dsrom_engram_lookup_campaign.json; routes await review

tables.row_layout: 256 E4M3 codes, 1 UE8M0 scale, 7 bytes free in the release -> CRC-32 of bytes 0..256 at 257..260 (this design), 0 at 261..263

access.index_depends_on: the last 4 compressed token ids only (NgramHashState): known when the token is known, before the embedding -- every lookup can be issued at token start

L1.op: L1.eng.* (wkv on the rows, then the gate on h)

L14.op: L14.eng.* (wkv on the rows, then the gate on h)

access.pattern: random rows (hash), exactly one row per hash column per token: column-banked storage never conflicts and splits evenly over 4 ranks by column

rom_option.carried_36_dies: inherited: HEAD_TABLE_DIES = 44 (8 head + 36 table) of the S = 58 C1 ledger (tools/dsrom_c_recheck.py:24), not derived from the tables. 36 x 858 = 30,888 mm2 holds them only at the Qwen-embedding density with ~93 % of every die placed, or as bare macros; at the 55-60 % rule the tables need the realistic_dies range
rom_option.transport: table trays at the bottom of rack R2 (rack.json packing) feed stage 3 (R1 top) and stage 42 over in-rack / rack-to-rack cable with full KP4 FEC (209 ns a leg); the 24 rows of a layer come from 24 column banks spread over many dies, so every home rank die needs a fan-in of table links
rom_option.design: a ROM table die = the S81 field generator's pair frames carrying table banks (column-banked, one row per column per token) + a per-die row reader + link endpoints; not built: rejected below

hbm_option.placement: layer L's table in the 4 rank dies of its home stage (3L: stage 3 for L1, stage 42 for L14); rank r holds hash columns 6r..6r+5 in a load-once read-only region of its own stacks
hbm_option.stacks_added_note: +1 HBM3E stack on each of the 8 home dies (1 -> 2): region 25.35 GB > 20.25 GB usable of one 22.5 GB shipping stack (technology.json); with Micron 12-high 36 GB stacks (32.4 GB usable) no stack is added (sensitivity)
hbm_option.load: written once at power-on (25.35 GB a die) through the die's host / KV-ingest port -- the port the completeness audit (finding 6) finds missing on every ROM die; at 32 GB/s ~0.8 s, all dies in parallel.  Read-only afterwards.
hbm_option.integrity: HBM3E on-die ECC + per-row CRC-32 in the release's 7 free bytes, checked by the engine; a bad row poisons its prefetch slot (no silent wrong value)

src.kv_per_user: tools/dsrom_return_storage_hbm.py kv_sizing: one stack holds 216 users at 1M on the busiest die

recommendation.choice: HBM-resident Engram tables on the home stages' rank dies (+8 HBM3E stacks), the 36 ROM table dies deleted
why: the index is a function of token ids only, so a 200-ns random HBM read is hidden: L1 slack 8,572 cycles, L14 235,129 (0 on the critical path)
bandwidth is negligible (1,728 B a token a die)
ROM needs 56-92 dies at 55-60 % util (not 36) and 5,171-8,496 W always-on; HBM needs 8 stacks and 22.4 W idle
no new links, no table trays, no rack-to-rack table cable; the rows stay inside the home stage
the same placement the HBM accelerator and the engram_hbm candidate config already use
costs: 8 extra HBM3E stacks and PHY/ctrl bands on 8 dies (a new die kind layer1e)
a table load path at power-on (needs the host/ingest port the audit finds missing)
DRAM is not ROM: integrity by ECC + per-row CRC with slot poisoning

die_change.links: unchanged: the rows' all-gather uses the TP4 collective (slab v4: lk_W0/E0 UCIe in-package, SerDes across the package pair); the lead flit uses the existing stage-hop SerDes

die_change.package: 2-die package with 4 stacks (2 a die) on the 4 home packages -- within the 8-stack B200-class interposer the rack already assumes (kv-lives-in-hbm: 4 per die is the limit)

transport.lead_flit: 72-bit window (4 x 17-bit compressed ids + dead) formed on S0 by ot_dsrom_engram_idwin, sent at token start as one control flit on each stage hop and forwarded cut-through to the home stages (stage 3, stage 42); +1 flit on a ~40,976-B hop (0.2 % occupancy)
transport.hbm: local: eng_SE <-> ctrl_SE (abutting faces), 6 requests of 9 x 32-B atoms
transport.allgather: TP4 collective: 1,584 B a rank of packed FP8 rows + 1 status a row; the sink merges 4 sources
transport.fec: the existing full-KP4 stage hops and collective links (owner 10-06)
